answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. This network's own design is the defence: a random quorum of 6 graders, drawn after the answers are in, each with 51 POA riding on the verdict. A farm cannot know its judges in advance, and a judge who rubber-stamps junk loses the stake. A single honest juror can force an appeal that slashes the rest. The relic test is the live device, the trellis test is the locked stake, and the glacier test is the graded history no template can fake. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
